title: Brazilian Chicken Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Indian-inspired stew made with chicken, potatoes, and spices. Perfect for a cold winter night.

ingredients.name: brazilian spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add potatoes, spices, and tomato. Stir to combine.
Add 1 cup of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
